protected:
    enabled:
      condition: enabled
      name: "{$p}%protection%"
      lore: |-
        {$sep}This block will be protected
        from all the players unless they're
        added manually to access the block.
      material: OAK_SIGN
      glow: true

      name: "&4%protection%"
      material: OAK_SIGN
      lore: |-
        {$sep}This block will be protected
        from all the players unless they're
        added manually to access the block.
    slot: 1
